blocks: type 3 = status/measurement frame · type 2 = active-settings frame · type 1 = write-settings frame

unmappedReports: Status-frame offset 3: detected nominal battery voltage (12/24/36/48 V). A configured system rating, not a measurement — no MetricKind covers it., Status-frame offset 5: controller error/alarm code. No MetricKind carries a fault bitmask; faults would have to become events instead., Status-frame offsets 1 and 2: undecoded status bytes. krahabb believes the top bit of offset 1 is load output state and that other bits track charging phase, but he could not decode charge-stage — so this dialect cannot report charge-stage even though the controller clearly knows it., Status-frame offset 13: a 16-bit Wh energy counter. Its reset period is not established (today vs lifetime), so it maps to neither pv-energy-today nor pv-energy-total until somebody watches it across a midnight., Config-frame writes have no CommandKind: equalize / boost / float / boost-recharge / load-reconnect / load-disconnect setpoint voltages, battery type, nominal system voltage, and load working mode are all settable over this bus and none of them is expressible in CommandKind. Only set-charge-current-limit and start-equalize exist, and neither is present here.
